howto: Pick an opponent (Easy, Medium or Hard bot, or 2 players) and a time control, then press Play.
You are White and move first. Tap a piece to see its moves, then tap a dot (or drag the piece).
Checkmate the black king: attack it so it has no escape.
The rules card (the ? key, or Replay tutorial) explains how every piece moves, castling and en passant.
tips: Control the centre early with pawns and knights.
Castle early to tuck your king away.
Before every move, check what your opponent is attacking.
Hint arrows the engine's move and says why; Undo takes a move back.
The Learn academy has openings, traps, endgames and a quiz.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys move the cursor, Enter or Space picks up and drops a piece, U undoes, R redoes, H hints, F flips, ? opens the rules. P pauses.
controls.touch: Tap or drag pieces; long-press to draw an arrow. The buttons beside the board do the rest.

difficulty: Easy bot picks among near-best moves one move deep, Medium searches two moves and Hard three, each with an opening book. Clocks from 1 to 10 minutes or unlimited.

cheats.effect: Extra queen: a white queen drops onto your side of the board
The bot naps: its next 3 moves are random
Auto hint: the best move is arrowed on every turn

features.rules-screen: The Rules card (goal, how each piece moves, castling, en passant) opens with the ? key, the help button and Pause > Replay tutorial
features.ai-difficulty: Easy, Medium and Hard bots on the start screen, plus bot personalities in the game
features.undo: Undo and Redo buttons (U and R keys)
features.results: Result card (win, loss, draw, resign or time) with moves played, plus Rematch, Share PGN and Review
